corrections: Replaced generic airframe with independently sampled side roof/belly and plan widths, long radome, hollow rectangular cabin, separate cockpit windscreen and asymmetric 7/8 passenger window pattern.

Authored constant-chord wing, 3-degree dihedral, separated flaps/ailerons, external flap hinges, bracing, PT6 nacelles, three-blade 2.59m propellers and fixed 4.53m wheelbase /3.70m track undercarriage.
Rebuilt Apex cockpit from C-GOVN photo: two outer PFDs, stacked center MFDs, standby cluster, lower electrical subpanels, shared pitch-column assembly, pedestal and overhead engine levers.
Visual iteration corrected rudder trailing edge, cabin window size, invalid side-window apertures that had disrupted skin triangulation, and deep coaming closure.
Wired actual simulation TAS, geometric altitude, true heading, attitude, VSI and both normalized engine RPM values; column, wheels, pedals, power levers, flaps, ailerons, elevator and rudder animate.
reviewNotes.visual: Personally inspected four final overlays, eight standard views and eleven detail/state views (zero, cruise, limits, below sea level, missing signals, both control extremes, overhead, control column, cabin and close exterior). Dedicated live state/Earth bridge test and final geometry/sightline check passed; candidate is byte-identical.
limitations: Manufacturer three-view is illustrative: plan length/wing span and front-view dihedral have small internal discrepancies. Printed dimensions and 3-degree dihedral take priority; mismatch remains visible in overlays.
Cockpit photograph is perspective, partly occluded and undimensioned. Uniform estimated 1.62m/1000px scaling establishes relative instrument layout, not surveyed panel depths; photo not warped.

PFD graphics are an original simplified live subset, not a Honeywell Apex emulation. TAS replaces IAS, geometric feet replace pressure altitude, heading is true, and normalized simulated engine RPM is labeled RPM %.
Navigation, radio, fuel, torque, ITT, Ng, oil and electrical systems are unavailable and blank or --. Switches and prop/condition levers are modeled without unsupported behavior.

Clean wheels variant only; no floats, skis or opening doors. Cabin upholstery, fastener spacing and detailed flap linkage are polygonal approximations; no claim of a complete engineering fastener map.
